title: Acrylonitrile butadiene styrene

why_it_matters.text: ABS: the tough, glossy plastic of LEGO bricks, keyboard keys and a common 3D printer filament. Three monomers give it hardness, toughness and gloss.

description: ABS: the tough, glossy plastic of LEGO bricks, keyboard keys and a common 3D printer filament. Three monomers give it hardness, toughness and gloss.

structure_repeat_unit.line: ABS has no single repeat unit: chains of styrene and acrylonitrile units are grafted onto, and blended with, a rubber made of butadiene units; the drawing shows the three units.
structure_repeat_unit.replaces: PubChem's record of it, CID 24756, is its three monomers, each with its double bond, what goes into the reactor and not what is in the plastic.
